title: Coop Net
summary: Authoritative co-op rooms and their clients on top of network-core: seats, per-seat input mailboxes with sequence numbers and acknowledgements, a fixed tick that calls the game's step, snapshot fan-out with a game-defined payload, and a client that sends input at its own sequence and hands snapshots back to the game.
dependencies: features/network-core (WebSocket server and client, codec, session limits)
